test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact model/accuracy/scenario, licensed hashed artifacts, official validity/accuracy success and an approved comparable threshold. BERT evidence, Server results, invalid logs or unbound score delta cannot pass.
safety_gate: Use only licensed approved model/data/container artifacts.

Abort on invalid accuracy/LoadGen state, thermal/power/ECC limit or platform instability.
Do not call an internal run an official submission; preserve all logs and restore settings.

Accuracy results and LoadGen validity/detail/summary logs
